I visited both sites, invited Dora to Slack, and sent each of them feedback.

- **Dora (www.dora-website.com):** The site is sparse, with only a one-line description and an email address. I suggested adding a short bio, a photo, sections on what she does, links to her work or social profiles, and a simple navigation menu. I sent this as a direct message after inviting her.

I used dora@gmail.com for Dora's invite because it's listed on her website. Let me know if you meant a different address.
